evidence.summary: Observed Setup catalog HTTP 502 transport while sign-in and smoke test rows are green.
Setup screenshot: catalog load HTTP 502 transport; sign-in and smoke test green.
Read AGENTS.md and docs/project-context.md; graph-insights/latest.md exists but is dated 2026-07-13 and explicitly stale.

Expected: Codex GET /backend-api/codex/models returns augmented catalog and successful_model_catalog_requests increments. Actual: installed Setup observed HTTP 502 classified transport while browser login and smoke test pass.
Source trace: modelsRequest calls forwardNativeCodexRequest; after dispatch starts, a thrown fetch is classified transport and returned as HTTP 502.
Historical installed daemon result request #1 at 2026-09-28T09:49:56.565Z was 502, transport, elapsed 128 ms, with no failure code; launcher logged the toast at 09:50:08.127Z.

Current installed loopback /healthz: runtime 5.0.6 PID 48076; 882 catalog requests, 843 successes, latest request #882 HTTP 200 at 2026-09-29T16:10:18.486Z. Launcher logged catalog verified on Sep 29.
Graph CLI index bound to coding-tools-mcp but status/query hung; code_insight degraded to lexical source evidence.

Reproduced live 2026-09-30 02:20-02:40Z: Coding Tools restarted at 02:20:03 while ProxyBridgeRewrite also restarted (PID 6840 -> 7552). browser.navigation_failed ERR_PROXY_CONNECTION_FAILED at 02:20:55; the relay logged browser.native_fetch_failed netError=ERR_PROXY_CONNECTION_FAILED at 02:21:02, 02:25:37, 02:30:12, 02:34:47, 02:36:33; the fresh daemon (pid 14580) recorded catalog requests #1-#19 as 502 (stage upstream when the relay answered 502 native_network_error; stage transport when the fetch to the relay was aborted at ~5 s or reset).
Recovery without any code change: /healthz at 02:45:44Z shows pid 14580, 24 catalog requests, 5 successful, last #24 HTTP 200 at 02:45:38Z; curl through 127.0.0.1:17891 exits loc=US.

Mechanism: startCatalogVerificationMonitor publishes the FIRST failed catalog result of a daemon with successful_model_catalog_requests < 1 as publishOperation({name: catalog-verification, status: failed}). When a later request succeeds it sets codexCatalogVerified but never publishes a replacement operation, so lastOperation stays failed; App.tsx re-raises any failed snapshot.operation as an error banner on every renderer load.

Root cause: because the catalog monitor reports the first failed catalog request of a fresh daemon as a final failure and never clears it once a later request succeeds, a transient outage of the launcher's route to chatgpt.com at startup (ProxyBridge restarting -> ERR_PROXY_CONNECTION_FAILED, or the relay endpoint changing across a launcher restart -> transport) leaves Setup reporting 'model catalog loading failed: HTTP 502' even after the catalog loads and sign-in/smoke pass. Ruled out: catalog augmentation/parsing (same code returns 200 once the route is up); ChatGPT sign-in path (green throughout); the 2026-09-30 control-server change (relay failed before headers with a net error, not a stream error).

Countermeasure chosen: when startCatalogVerificationMonitor marks the catalog verified and the last published operation is the catalog-verification failure, publish {name: catalog-verification, status: completed} so the stale failure stops re-raising as an error banner. Effective: removes the misleading Setup failure once any catalog request succeeds. Feasible: one hunk in main.cjs; the installed main.cjs monitor is byte-identical to source. Regression risk: low; only replaces an operation of the same name, never a different running/failed operation. Rejected for now: a startup grace period before reporting (larger change, hides real failures longer). Out of scope: ProxyBridge restarts themselves (external).
startCatalogVerificationMonitor publishes {name: catalog-verification, status: completed} when it marks the catalog verified and lastOperation is the catalog-verification failure.

renderer-wiring 'catalog verification reports a failed request ... then recovers' now asserts the recovery replaces the failure (lastOperation completed). Fails without the fix (expected 2 operations, got 1), passes with it. Full desktop suite: 56 failures before and after, none new.

Reviewed cc16f6fa. Finding: it fixes the stale failure on renderer reload, but a banner already raised in a live session stayed until dismissed because onOperation only ever set errors. Fixed in 88180ff9: a completed operation clears only the error raised by the same operation's earlier failure. Also checked: the completed operation is published only when lastOperation is the catalog-verification failure, so it never replaces a different running or failed operation. renderer-wiring tests pass apart from the pre-existing Agent Orchestrator sidebar failure.

Correction to the src8-4 evidence: of the model_catalog_failed lines logged 02:20-02:46Z, 1558 were old daemon stderr replayed at startup (inner 'at' hours older than the log time); only 19 were live (#1-#19, 02:21:02-02:37:07), all during browser.native_fetch_failed ERR_PROXY_CONNECTION_FAILED. The 'relay endpoint changing across a launcher restart' path has no live evidence; the root cause rests on the proxy outage alone. The fix does not depend on that path.
